operation.author: szymoniwacz
operation.body:
### Goal

Close **FR-008** by making the demo reproducible: add a small synthetic sample dataset via `db/seeds.rb`, document actual setup/run/test commands, and align project-facing documentation with what is delivered on `main` (including links to real goals and PRs).

### Acceptance criteria

- `bin/rails db:seed` (or `db:setup` / documented flow) loads a small synthetic sample of feedback items covering each allowed category without requiring manual UI entry for a first demo.
- README reflects the implemented app (not “not implemented yet”), lists verified setup, server, test, and seed commands, and links to actual delegated goals/PRs for the product build where appropriate.
- Update `.ai/project/roadmap.md`, `.ai/project/product-context.md` (if status text is stale), and `docs/demo-guide.md` so they match delivered behaviour and checks; do not edit `docs/security-review.md` (goal #3).
- Run `bin/rails db:test:prepare test`, `bash tests/test-adapter.sh`, and `./scripts/check-workflow-leak.sh`; report results in the PR validation section.
- Keep changes reviewable in one PR; branch name includes `issue-<n>`.

### Constraints

Parent project authorization is `self-correcting-review auto-merge`. Inherit eligible auto-merge when preconditions are met.

### Out of scope

Authentication, production deployment, CI workflow redesign, `docs/security-review.md`, and new product features beyond sample data and documentation accuracy.

### Relevant context

FR-001–FR-007 are implemented on `main` (goals #12–#24; PRs #13–#25). `db/seeds.rb` is currently empty. README status line is outdated. See `.ai/docs/project-requirements.md` FR-008 and acceptance details on documentation consistency.

<!-- project-executor:goal project=szymoniwacz/feedback-inbox#2 -->
operation.title: [Agent Goal]: Reproducible demo and docs (FR-008)
